description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for a customer management and billing system. It includes CRUD operations for customers, invoices, invoice items, payments, reminders, and some reporting endpoints such as analytics and balance sheets.

methods.name: create_customer(customer: schemas.CustomerCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database.

methods.name: list_customers(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns a list of all customers, optionally ordered.

methods.name: get_customer(customer_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific customer by ID.

methods.name: update_customer(customer_id: int, customer: schemas.CustomerUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates an existing customer record.

methods.name: delete_customer(customer_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a customer record.

methods.name: create_invoice(invoice: schemas.InvoiceCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new invoice along with its items.

methods.name: list_invoices(customer_id: Optional[int] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Lists all invoices, optionally filtered by customer.

methods.name: get_invoice(invoice_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific invoice.

methods.name: update_invoice(invoice_id: int, invoice: schemas.InvoiceUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates invoice details and associated items.

methods.name: delete_invoice(invoice_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes an invoice and its items.

methods.name: create_payment(payment: schemas.PaymentCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Records a new payment.

methods.name: list_payments(customer_id: Optional[int] = None, invoice_id: Optional[int] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Lists all payments, optionally filtered.

methods.name: get_payment(payment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific payment.

methods.name: update_payment(payment_id: int, payment: schemas.PaymentUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates a payment record.

methods.name: delete_payment(payment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a payment record.

methods.name: create_reminder(reminder: schemas.ReminderCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new reminder.

methods.name: list_reminders(customer_id: Optional[int] = None, status: Optional[str] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Lists reminders, optionally filtered by customer or status.

methods.name: update_reminder(reminder_id: int, reminder: schemas.ReminderCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates an existing reminder.

methods.name: delete_reminder(reminder_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a reminder.

methods.name: frequent_purchases(customer_id: Optional[int] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Provides statistics of top purchased items per customer.

methods.name: customer_balance(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Calculates total invoice amount, total paid, and outstanding balance per customer.

methods.name: export_balance_sheet(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Exports the customer balance sheet as a CSV file.
